companies.name: Michael Paul Enterprises
companies.quote: Mr. D'Alessio is a real estate developer who has owned and operated his own real estate company, Michael Paul Enterprises, and its predecessors, for over 25 years, having developed residential and commercial projects including office buildings, shopping centers as well as real estate sales, leasing and property management activities.
